description: 1. Six-phase pipeline for creating Huawei Cloud skills — Socratic requirements gathering, CLI→SDK→API research, MD generation, test preparation, detailed testing, and final cleanup & compliance check 2. Phase-chained dependency: each phase builds on the previous phase's output, no phase may be skipped 3. Supports CLI, SDK, and REST API execution modes with automatic fallback detection 4. Generates complete skill directory structure with SKILL.md, references/, scripts/, templates/ 5.
